title: Todo App Container Registry Schema
description: Defines the internal storage format for the broker's container registry. The registry tracks all provisioned blob containers and their lifecycle status. It is infrastructure-only: no domain data (user profiles, org names, memberships) lives here.

Registry.title: Registry
Registry.description: The root registry document stored as a single blob. Contains the inventory of all provisioned containers. Concurrency is managed via blob ETags.

containers.description: All provisioned blob containers in the system.

Container.title: Container
Container.description: A provisioned blob container. The container name is derived deterministically from the entity identity (e.g. user-{hash} for personal storage, om-{hash}-{hash} for org-member storage).

name.description: The physical Azure Blob container name (lowercase, 3-63 chars).

entityType.description: What kind of entity this container belongs to.

entityId.description: The identity subject (sub) that owns this container.

orgId.description: For organization-member containers, the organization ID.

status.description: Current provisioning status of this container.

EntityType.title: Entity Type
EntityType.description: The kind of entity a container stores data for.

ContainerStatus.title: Container Status
ContainerStatus.description: Lifecycle status of a container. Starts as 'provisioning' while being created, becomes 'active' once ready, or 'failed' if provisioning could not complete.
